Fist of Bane Gasper Throaks is a cultist of Bane and son of  Blarson and  Clovia Throaks.

Involvement

Gasper is in the Steel Watch Foundry in the Lower City, next to  Iron Consul Chadd. He guards the Steel Watch Foundry and watches over the Gondians who are forced to work there to produce the Steel Watchers for Gortash.

Idle banter

Gasper Throaks will occasionally chat with Chadd:

  • Fist of Bane Gasper Throaks
    I heard you were disciplined by Overseer Holzt, Dread Brother.
  • Iron Consul Chadd
    When instructing a Gondian, my enthusiasm overtook me - I cut off her hand.
  • Fist of Bane Gasper Throaks
    Clumsy - what good are they without their limbs?
  • Iron Consul Chadd
    Indeed - I had to dispose of her.
  • Iron Consul Chadd
    I crossed the line between domination and pacification. I failed the Black Hand.
  • Fist of Bane Gasper Throaks
    Your dedication to Bane's tenets is admirable, Dread Brother.
  • Iron Consul Chadd
    It is not enough. I fear what Lord Gortash will say.
  • Fist of Bane Gasper Throaks
    Lord Gortash is blessed as unholy Bane's favoured. His judgement is final.
  • Iron Consul Chadd
    I know - I am grateful for my service to Lord Gortash.
